create_sigmoid_bijector: create a Sigmoid bijector instance for computing logistic sigmoid transformations
forward_log_det_jacobian: compute the log determinant of the Jacobian for a given input array x
forward_and_log_det: compute both the forward sigmoid mapping and its log determinant Jacobian together
inverse_and_log_det: compute the inverse sigmoid mapping and its log determinant Jacobian from output y
same_as_sigmoid: check if another bijector is guaranteed to be the same Sigmoid bijector instance
